newsitem.title: GREECE: NATL MORTGAGE DISMISSES RUMOURS, SAYS Q1 UP.
newsitem.headline: NATL MORTGAGE DISMISSES RUMOURS, SAYS Q1 UP.

text.p: National Mortgage Bank of Greece dismissed market rumours of disappointing first quarter 1997 performance which pressured its share 2.25 percent lower on Monday, saying first quarter results where up on 1996.
National Mortgage Bank treasurer George Papoutsis, speaking on behalf of the bank's governor Vassilis Rapanos told Reuters the rumours circulating in the market were unfounded.
"The bank's first quarter results are higher than in the same period a year earlier and will be announced soon," Papoutsis said. "The rumours are unfounded."

Shares of National Mortgage fell 2.25 percent or 1,480 drachmas to settle at 19,610, pulling the bank sector lower. The respective index coughed up 2.25 percent, more than the market's 1.83 percent drop. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
